# `company.shipment_return_lines`

Immutable lines of a shipment return: which shipment line, how many, and the receipt movement.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this line. |
| `return_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with return_id + position | — | shipment_returns.id | Shipment return this line belongs to. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with return_id + position | — | — | One-based position within the return. |
| `shipment_line_identity` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_return_lines_identity | — | Stable identity of the shipment line given back. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | items.id | Item returned. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity returned in the item's base unit, microunits. |
| `movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_return_lines_movement | inventory_movements.id | Receipt movement the line posted, naming the shipment line's issue. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment return line was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment return line. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment return line. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment return line. |
